title: commits
description: A commit of a repository, with its full patch. The full set (commits.jsonl) and the filtered set (commits_filtered.jsonl) use this schema. Key: repo, sha.

repo.description: Repository as owner/name, as requested at collection time.

corpus.description: Corpus of the repository. A: every commit, issue and pull request. B: commits whose message names a PQC term or that belong to a pull request whose title or body names one, and issues and pull requests whose title or body names one. C: repositories with no issues or pull requests; every commit.

sha.description: Commit SHA. The same SHA can occur in several repositories.

url.description: Link to the commit on GitHub.

author_key.description: Opaque key of the Git author e-mail address (HMAC-SHA256 under a secret the dataset maintainers keep). Equal keys mean the same address; the address cannot be recovered or tested from the key.

authored_at.description: Git author time, with the author's UTC offset.

parents.description: Parent SHAs; more than one for a merge commit.

pr_numbers.description: Numbers of the collected pull requests of the same repository that contain the commit; empty means no collected pull request contains it, not that it was pushed directly.

pr_urls.description: Links to those PRs on GitHub, in the same order as pr_numbers.

on_default_branch.description: True if the commit is reachable from the repository's default branch, as observed when it was mined.

in_merged_pr.description: True if GitHub associates the commit with a merged pull request of the same repository, as observed when it was mined; can be true when pr_numbers is empty, because only keyword-selected pull requests are collected in tier B.

pqc_in_linked_text.description: True if a PQC term appears in the title or body of a pull request of the same repository that GitHub associates with the commit, or of an issue such a pull request closes, as observed when the commit was mined. null when not observed: commits on no default branch and in no merged pull request.

changed_files.description: Files changed against the first parent (an empty tree for a root commit).

status.description: A added, M modified, D deleted, T type changed.

additions.description: Lines added; null for a binary file.

deletions.description: Lines deleted; null for a binary file.

patch_encoding.description: Encoding of patch_content: utf-8, or base64 when the patch is not valid UTF-8.

patch_content.description: Full git diff against the first parent (an empty tree for a root commit), including binary changes.
